_meaning.exp2_n_flies: Number of flies in the burden-matched experiment (results/exp2/battery.csv).
_meaning.exp2_n_healthy: Number of exp2 healthy flies (map == healthy, s = 0), the reference for all exp2 percentages.
_meaning.exp2_n_per_group: Smallest number of flies in any exp2 map x level group (all groups have this n).
_meaning.series_n_healthy: Number of series healthy flies (stage 0 of stage_curve_x4.csv, scope pan), the reference for equal-neuron percentages.
_meaning.exp2_seed_range: Smallest and largest pathology seed of the 288 exp2 flies.
_meaning.syn11.5_target_contacts_lost_pct: Target fraction of functional synaptic contacts lost (%), the calibration mean of the hub map at s = 0.1 (matched.json), defining level syn11.5.
_meaning.syn11.5_hub_severity_s: Severity s at which the hub map removes the target contacts of level syn11.5 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.syn11.5_shuffled_severity_s: Severity s at which the shuffled map removes the target contacts of level syn11.5 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.syn11.5_antihub_severity_s: Severity s at which the antihub map removes the target contacts of level syn11.5 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.syn27.1_target_contacts_lost_pct: Target fraction of functional synaptic contacts lost (%), the calibration mean of the hub map at s = 0.25 (matched.json), defining level syn27.1.
_meaning.syn27.1_hub_severity_s: Severity s at which the hub map removes the target contacts of level syn27.1 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.syn27.1_shuffled_severity_s: Severity s at which the shuffled map removes the target contacts of level syn27.1 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.syn27.1_antihub_severity_s: Severity s at which the antihub map removes the target contacts of level syn27.1 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.syn48.3_target_contacts_lost_pct: Target fraction of functional synaptic contacts lost (%), the calibration mean of the hub map at s = 0.5 (matched.json), defining level syn48.3.
_meaning.syn48.3_hub_severity_s: Severity s at which the hub map removes the target contacts of level syn48.3 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.syn48.3_shuffled_severity_s: Severity s at which the shuffled map removes the target contacts of level syn48.3 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.syn48.3_antihub_severity_s: Severity s at which the antihub map removes the target contacts of level syn48.3 (matched.json; null = unreachable).
_meaning.exp2_max_abs_dev_contacts_lost_pp: Largest absolute difference (percentage points) between a group's median measured contacts lost and its level target, over the 8 exp2 map x level groups.
_meaning.max_reachable_contacts_lost_pct_hub: Largest fraction of contacts lost (%) the hub map reaches within s <= 1 (calibration mean of 3 draws at s = 1; matched.json).
_meaning.max_reachable_contacts_lost_pct_shuffled: Largest fraction of contacts lost (%) the shuffled map reaches within s <= 1 (calibration mean of 3 draws at s = 1; matched.json).
_meaning.max_reachable_contacts_lost_pct_antihub: Largest fraction of contacts lost (%) the antihub map reaches within s <= 1 (calibration mean of 3 draws at s = 1; matched.json).
_meaning.syn11.5_hub_contacts_lost_pct: Median per-fly fraction of functional synaptic contacts lost (%) in the 32 exp2 flies of the hub map at level syn11.5 (s = 0.1).
_meaning.syn11.5_hub_neurons_removed_pct: Median per-fly fraction of all neurons removed (%) in the 32 exp2 flies of the hub map at level syn11.5 (s = 0.1).
_meaning.syn11.5_hub_KC_removed_pct: Median per-fly fraction of Kenyon cells removed (%) in the 32 exp2 flies of the hub map at level syn11.5 (s = 0.1).
_meaning.syn11.5_hub_mean_load: Median per-fly mean pathology load in the 32 exp2 flies of the hub map at level syn11.5 (s = 0.1). The per-fly mean (mean_load = f.load.mean()) is over ALL neurons of the fly, including sensory neurons (ineligible for pathology, load 0) and removed neurons (counted with their load although their threshold is set to infinity). Each neuron's firing threshold is lowered by its load x 2.0 mV.
_meaning.syn11.5_hub_mean_threshold_shift_mV: Median per-fly mean threshold DECREASE (mV) = mean load x dth_max (2.0 mV) in the 32 exp2 flies of the hub map at level syn11.5 (s = 0.1): pathology lowers the firing threshold (v_th - load x dth_max, adfly/pathology.py). The per-fly mean (mean_load = f.load.mean()) is over ALL neurons of the fly, including sensory neurons (ineligible for pathology, load 0) and removed neurons (counted with their load although their threshold is set to infinity).
_meaning.syn11.5_hub_brain_pct: Median whole-brain spike count during odour A (brain_spikes_A) as % of the exp2 healthy median, [estimate, 95% bootstrap lo, hi], in the 32 exp2 flies of the hub map at level syn11.5 (s = 0.1).

_meaning.syn48.3_brain_ratio_high_low_maxmin: Ratio of the highest to the lowest map median of whole-brain spike count during odour A (brain_spikes_A) at level syn48.3, [point, 95% CI of the per-resample max/min over maps (analyze_exp2.py statistic)]. Max/min is at least 1 in every resample, so the lower bound is at least 1 by construction: this interval tests the prespecified 1.27 criterion, not 'no difference' between maps. With only two maps (hub, shuffled), quote syn48.3_shuffled_over_hub_brain_ratio for a two-sided comparison. The lower bound lies close to the 1.27 criterion: over 300 bootstrap seeds it averages 1.259 (range 1.240 to 1.276) and exceeds 1.27 in 3% of seeds.
_meaning.syn48.3_brain_ratio_high_low_pair: Ratio of the highest to the lowest map median of whole-brain spike count during odour A (brain_spikes_A) at level syn48.3, [point, 95% CI with the two maps fixed at the observed highest (shuffled) and lowest (hub)].
_meaning.syn48.3_brain_highest_lowest_map: Maps with the highest and the lowest median whole-brain spike count during odour A (brain_spikes_A) at level syn48.3.

_meaning._mc_check: Monte Carlo check of every bootstrap interval: [number of alternative seeds, first, last, flag threshold as a fraction of the bound, minimum range in rounding steps, seeds for the prespecified-verdict check]. The whole file is recomputed with each alternative seed; a bound is flagged when its range over all seeds exceeds both thresholds (its second significant figure is not reproducible) or it is infinite in only some seeds, and the range is appended to the key's meaning. Post hoc verdicts that change across these seeds are flagged as well.
_meaning._mc_sensitive_keys: Keys whose interval bounds or verdict changed beyond the _mc_check thresholds across bootstrap seeds; quote their bounds to at most 2 significant figures.
